WITH RECURSIVE emp_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.first_name,
    e.last_name,
    e.reports_to,
    0 AS level
  FROM chinook.employee AS e
  WHERE
    e.reports_to IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.first_name,
    e.last_name,
    e.reports_to,
    eh.level + 1
  FROM chinook.employee AS e
  JOIN emp_hierarchy AS eh
    ON e.reports_to = eh.employee_id
)
SELECT
  employee_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  level
FROM emp_hierarchy
ORDER BY
  level,
  employee_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT

SELECT
  order_date,
  SUM(oi.amount) AS daily_revenue
FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_date >= '2022-06-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2022-07-01'
  AND oi.amount IS NOT NULL

  order_date

  order_date

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date) AS month,
    SUM(oi.amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
  JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%' AND oi.amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date)
), growth AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  prev_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0
    THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((
      (
        revenue - prev_revenue
      ) / prev_revenue
    ) * 100, 2)
  END AS growth_pct
FROM growth
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 100

WITH state_category_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    o.ship_state AS state,
    p.category AS category,
    SUM(oi.amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
  JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecommerce.products AS p
    ON oi.sku = p.sku
  WHERE
    o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%' AND oi.amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    o.ship_state,
    p.category
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    category,
    revenue,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk
  FROM state_category_revenue
), top_states AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_state_revenue
  FROM state_category_revenue
  GROUP BY
    state
  ORDER BY
    total_state_revenue DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  r.state,
  r.category,
  r.revenue
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN top_states AS ts
  ON r.state = ts.state
WHERE
  r.rnk = 1
ORDER BY
  ts.total_state_revenue DESC,
  r.state,
  r.category
LIMIT 100

WITH sku_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    oi.sku,
    SUM(oi.amount) AS sku_total
  FROM ecommerce.order_items AS oi
  JOIN ecommerce.orders AS o
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE
    oi.amount IS NOT NULL AND o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%'
  GROUP BY
    oi.sku
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    sku_total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sku_total DESC) AS rn
  FROM sku_revenue
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN sku_total ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sku_total), 0),
    2
  ) AS top10_share_pct
FROM ranked
LIMIT 1000

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM o.order_date) AS day_of_week,
    AVG(daily_revenue) AS avg_daily_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT 
        o.order_date,
        SUM(oi.amount) AS daily_revenue
    FROM ecommerce.order_items oi
    JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE oi.amount IS NOT NULL
      AND o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%'
    GROUP BY o.order_date
) daily
GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM daily.order_date)
ORDER BY avg_daily_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

  ) AS percentage

SELECT

WITH team_wins AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.winner AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM ipl.matches AS m
  WHERE
    m.winner IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    m.season,
    m.winner
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    team,
    wins,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY wins DESC) AS rnk
  FROM team_wins
)
SELECT
  season,
  team,
  wins
FROM ranked
WHERE
  rnk = 1
ORDER BY
  season,
  team
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  d.bowler,
  COUNT(*) AS legal_balls,
  SUM(d.total_runs) AS total_runs,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.total_runs) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS economy_rate
FROM ipl.deliveries AS d
JOIN ipl.matches AS m
  ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
  m.season >= 2018 AND d.phase = 'death' AND d.extras_type IS NULL
GROUP BY
  d.bowler
HAVING
  COUNT(*) >= 300
ORDER BY
  economy_rate ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH team_runs AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    batter,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY SUM(runs) DESC) AS rn
  FROM ipl.batting_innings
  WHERE
    season = 2023
  GROUP BY
    team,
    batter
)
SELECT
  team,
  batter,
  total_runs
FROM team_runs
WHERE
  rn <= 3
ORDER BY
  team,
  total_runs DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH first_innings_totals AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    d.match_id,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_total
  FROM ipl.deliveries AS d
  JOIN ipl.matches AS m
    ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE
    d.inning = 1
  GROUP BY
    m.season,
    d.match_id
), season_avg AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    AVG(first_innings_total) AS avg_first_innings_total
  FROM first_innings_totals
  GROUP BY
    season
)
SELECT
  s1.season,
  s1.avg_first_innings_total,
  s1.avg_first_innings_total - s2.avg_first_innings_total AS change_from_previous_season
FROM season_avg AS s1
LEFT JOIN season_avg AS s2
  ON s2.season = s1.season - 1
ORDER BY
  s1.season
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  bi.batter,
  SUM(bi.runs) AS total_runs
FROM ipl.batting_innings AS bi
JOIN ipl.matches AS m
  ON bi.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
  m.result = 'wickets'
GROUP BY
  bi.batter
ORDER BY
  total_runs DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH yearly_genre_counts AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date_added) AS year_added,
    tg.genre,
    COUNT(*) AS title_count
  FROM netflix.titles AS t
  JOIN netflix.title_genres AS tg
    ON t.show_id = tg.show_id
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date_added) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2021
  GROUP BY
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date_added),
    tg.genre
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    year_added,
    genre,
    title_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year_added ORDER BY title_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM yearly_genre_counts
)
SELECT
  year_added,
  genre,
  title_count
FROM ranked
WHERE
  rnk = 1
ORDER BY
  year_added,
  genre
LIMIT 100

    2
  ) AS percentage_indian
FROM netflix.titles AS t
LEFT JOIN netflix.title_countries AS tc
  ON t.show_id = tc.show_id
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date_added) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2021

  year_added

  WHERE
    o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'

  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)

WITH state_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    c.state
  FROM olist.orders AS o
  JOIN olist.customers AS c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE
    c.state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG')
), category_gmv AS (
  SELECT
    so.state,
    p.category_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS gmv,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY so.state ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM olist.order_items AS oi
  JOIN state_orders AS so
    ON oi.order_id = so.order_id
  JOIN olist.products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY
    so.state,
    p.category_english
)
SELECT
  state,
  category_english,
  gmv
FROM category_gmv
WHERE
  rnk <= 3
ORDER BY
  state,
  gmv DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT

  FROM startups.funding_rounds AS fr
  WHERE
    fr.funding_date IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.amount_usd IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fr.funding_date) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2017
  GROUP BY
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fr.funding_date) AS INT),
    fr.startup_name
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    yr,
    startup_name,
    total_funding,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY total_funding DESC) AS rnk
  FROM yearly_startup_funding
)

  yr,
  startup_name,
  total_funding
FROM ranked

  rnk <= 3

  yr,
  rnk,
